robotpuVoice: Robot PU Voice - a text to speech extension for the micro:bit V2 based on SAM (Software Automatic Mouth, 1982). Speech is rendered on a background fiber so the robot can keep moving while it talks. The audio pipeline is powered down automatically when speech ends, so pin 0 does not keep driving the Robot PU amplifier.
VoicePreset: Voice presets based on the original SAM voice personalities, plus a signature Robot PU voice.
SingNote: Musical notes for the "sing note" block, mapped to SAM pitch numbers. SAM pitch is inversely proportional to frequency (smaller = higher), following pitch = 30000 / Hz, so middle C (C4) is 115 - the same number MicroPython's speech.sing() uses for "Do" in the solfege example.
robotpuVoice.say: Speak English text in the background. Digits are spoken as numbers, e.g. "level 3" is pronounced "level three". Returns immediately unless the utterance queue is full, in which case it waits for room so nothing is dropped; use "say and wait" or "wait until speech finished" to block until the words have been spoken.
robotpuVoice.say|param|text: words to say, eg: "Hello, I am Robot PU"
robotpuVoice.sayAndWait: Speak English text and wait until it has finished playing.
robotpuVoice.pronounce: Pronounce a string of SAM phonemes in the background. e.g. "I am a computer" is "AY4 AEM AH KUMPYUW3TER". See the README for the full phoneme table.
robotpuVoice.sing: Sing English text in the background using SAM's sing mode, which holds the pitch steady instead of adding natural inflection.
robotpuVoice.singPhonemes: Sing a string of SAM phonemes with pitch markers, like MicroPython's speech.sing(). Each "#nnn" sets the pitch for the phonemes after it (smaller numbers are higher); repeat vowel phonemes to hold a note. e.g. "#115DOWWWWWW #103REYYYYYY #94MIYYYYYY" sings Do-Re-Mi.
robotpuVoice.singNote: Sing one musical note. Give the syllable to sing (SAM phonemes, e.g. "DOW" for "doe") and how much to stretch the vowel to hold the note. Use SingNote.Rest to stay quiet for the same length a note with that hold would take - no millisecond maths needed.
robotpuVoice.singNote|param|note: the note to sing, eg: SingNote.C4
robotpuVoice.singNote|param|syllable: SAM phonemes for the syllable, eg: "DOW"
robotpuVoice.singNote|param|hold: extra vowel repetitions to lengthen the note, eg: 4
robotpuVoice.singRest: Rest for a number of beats, measured in "hold" units so it stretches the same way the sung notes do - no millisecond maths needed.
robotpuVoice.singRest|param|hold: how many beats to stay quiet, eg: 4
robotpuVoice.rest: Stay quiet for a while. Rests are queued just like notes, so they play at exactly the right moment between sung phrases - handy for a singer that joins the song late, or a breath between phrases.
robotpuVoice.rest|param|ms: how long to keep quiet, in milliseconds, eg: 500
robotpuVoice.sayPlayable: A spoken phrase for the music "play" block. e.g. music.play(robotpuVoice.sayPlayable("hello"), music.PlaybackMode.UntilDone)
robotpuVoice.singPlayable: Sung words for the music "play" block - English text chanted on a flat pitch in SAM's sing mode. e.g. music.play(robotpuVoice.singPlayable("daisy"), music.PlaybackMode.UntilDone)
robotpuVoice.singNotePlayable: A sung note for the music "play" block. Give the note, the syllable to sing (SAM phonemes, e.g. "DOW" for "doe") and how long to hold it - the "beat" picker from the music category plugs straight in. Pick "rest" as the note to stay quiet for the duration. e.g. music.play(robotpuVoice.singNotePlayable(SingNote.C4, "DOW", music.beat(BeatFraction.Whole)), music.PlaybackMode.UntilDone)
robotpuVoice.singNotePlayable|param|note: the note to sing, eg: SingNote.C4
robotpuVoice.singNotePlayable|param|syll: SAM phonemes for the syllable, eg: "DOW"
robotpuVoice.singNotePlayable|param|dura: how long the note lasts, in milliseconds
robotpuVoice.singRestPlayable: A sung rest for the music "play" block - silence that stays queued in sequence with the notes around it. e.g. music.play(robotpuVoice.singRestPlayable(music.beat(BeatFraction.Half)), music.PlaybackMode.UntilDone)
robotpuVoice.singRestPlayable|param|dura: how long to stay quiet, in milliseconds
robotpuVoice.singPhonemesPlayable: Sung SAM phonemes with #nnn pitch markers for the music "play" block, like MicroPython's speech.sing(). e.g. "#115DOWWWWWW #103REYYYYYY #94MIYYYYYY" sings Do-Re-Mi.
robotpuVoice.stopSpeaking: Stop speaking. Clears queued utterances and abandons the rest of the utterance currently being rendered.
robotpuVoice.isSpeaking: Check if Robot PU is speaking or still has speech queued.
robotpuVoice.waitUntilDone: Wait until all queued speech has finished playing.
robotpuVoice.onSpeechFinished: Run some code when all queued speech has finished playing.
robotpuVoice.setVoice|param|preset: the voice to use, eg: VoicePreset.RobotPU
robotpuVoice.configureVoice|param|speed: how quickly the voice talks, 0 slow - 255 fast, eg: 150
robotpuVoice.configureVoice|param|pitch: how high or low the voice sounds, eg: 48
robotpuVoice.configureVoice|param|mouth: how tight-lipped or enunciating the voice sounds, eg: 150
robotpuVoice.configureVoice|param|throat: how relaxed or tense the tone of voice is, eg: 180
robotpuVoice.setSingTempo: Set the singing tempo as a percent of the voice's normal speed. 100 sings at the preset's own pace, 200 is twice as fast, 50 is half speed. Talking speed is not affected. Set to 0 to sing at the voice's own speed again.
robotpuVoice.setSingTempo|param|tempo: percent of normal singing speed, eg: 100
robotpuVoice.setVolume: Set the audio output volume. This controls the micro:bit mixer, so it also affects music blocks.
robotpuVoice.useOnboardSpeaker: Route audio to the micro:bit's on-board speaker.
robotpuVoice.useOnboardSpeaker|param|on: true to enable the on-board speaker, eg: true
robotpuVoice.outputToPin0: Route audio to the edge connector pin (pin 0). This is the output that drives the Robot PU speaker amplifier.
robotpuVoice.outputToPin0|param|on: true to enable audio on pin 0, eg: true
robotpuVoice.powerDownAudio: Power the audio pipeline down immediately. Normally this happens automatically when speech finishes; this block forces it, which stops PWM on pin 0 so the amplifier idles.
robotpuVoice.toPhonemes: Convert English text into the SAM phoneme string it would be spoken as. Useful for tuning pronunciation. Returns an empty string while speech is in progress.
